attached-files-raw.Dockerfile:
FROM ackon/base

ADD in in

ENTRYPOINT '/bin/cp' 'in/sharded/one.txt' 'out/sharded/one.txt'
attached-files-raw.scaling.yaml:
scaling:
  nodes:
    maxUsedNodesInParallel: 120
    maxExecutionTime: 15
    maxNodeQueue: 3
  download:
    jitter: 10s
    factor: miliseconds
  upload:
    jitter: 30s
    factor: seconds
attached-files-raw.duplication.yaml:
task:
  redundancy: 1
  priorities:
    country: false  # This is very slow for online check :-) waiting to run may be ~10minutes. Setting to false.
    provider: false # This option take effect with `country` option. Will be ignored. Setting to false.
    owner: false    # This option take effect only if Coordinator set it to `ignore`. My coordinator automatically manage optimization on him region.
    rack: true      # shard by rack+server (not run copies of tasks on same rack and same server.
    hardware: true  #
